item.tib: de kho na nyid bzhi pa
item.coloph: de kho na nyid bzhi pa Dom+bis pas mdzad pa rdzogs so/ /rgya gar gyi slob dpon bud+d+ha gup+ta'i zhal sngar man ngag tsam mnos shing / slad kyi paN+Di ta nirba na shrI'i spyan sngar/ mar me mdzad dpal gyi 'grel pa dang stun te sgyur ba'o/ sngon 'di la rdo rje'i tshig bsdus pa chung ba zer/ na ro pa'i slob dpon rgyun rnams nyan bshad byed pa dang / badz+ra pA Ni'i phyag rgya bzhi pa la/ rdo rje tshig bsdus che ba zer/ mai tri pa'i slob ma rnams 'chad nyan byed pa byung ba yin lags
